label: About
title: About An Opening Above the Blue
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1212 recent saved-signal files and 319 captured links, then narrowed the page to 6 source windows around Blue fold beneath the opening and @MattNiessner: 📢GaussianGPT: autoregressive 3D Gaussian scene generation. We introduce a..., plus 4 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became An Opening Above the Blue: Low-key architectural section, elevated oblique cutaway with a close black foreground rail and deep stair recesses. Split rough olive-gray masonry into two offset masses around a broad empty interval. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Exposed blue lapel and shoulder above the diagonal foreground rail, Central landing floor terminating against deep vertical walls, and Unequal stepped cuts along the upper-left landing edge.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
